content.text: Submitted. The proposal now cures the minimality failures by replacing the 157-word rewrite of § 2(d) with a single concise inserted § 2(e) that leaves the existing sentence byte-for-byte intact (which also supplies the Vendor pre-existing-IP retention element), drops the undefined "Client Content" term, and keeps the full preferred level: Client ownership plus TrueLink assignment of Support Services deliverables and work product, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP with use, modification and sublicensing, Client retention of its IP and data (with the § 8(d) Credit Data licence carved out), and no joint ownership.
